sentences.text: Welcome back to the Slow English Podcast.
In this episode, we visit Hungary again.
Shagged is in the south of Hungary.
This city has a happy rhythm.
Shagged is near the Tisa River.
The land is flat, but the city is easy to move around.
Shagged is one of the sunniest cities in Hungary.
Light plays a big role here.
The city faced floods in the past, but it rebuilt.
After hard times, Shagged became stronger.
Many buildings are from the 19th century.
The main square is very important.
University City Shagged is a student city.
Youth gives life to the city.
Shagged is famous for food, especially paprika.
This was Emily on the Slow English Podcast.
